briefdescription.para: Symbolic dimension-expression utilities for ONNX shape inference.

detaileddescription.para: Provides a lightweight AST-based library for parsing, simplifying, evaluating, and renaming symbolic shape expressions such as those produced during ONNX shape inference (e.g. "2*batch//2" → "batch").

sect2.title: Overview
sect2.para: Shape expressions are strings that contain integer constants, symbolic variable names, and the arithmetic operators +, -, *, //, %, ^ (encodes max), and & (encodes min).
